ask.heading: What do you need to get done?
ask.subheading: Describe it in your own words. Every answer comes from a verified knowledge base, not from a chatbot's memory.
ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: For example: I need to renew my passport

errors.tooLong: That is too long. Please shorten it to {max} characters or fewer.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: The guidance service is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

notCovered.title: Not covered yet
notCovered.body: This service is not in the knowledge base, so there is nothing verified to show you. Rather than guess, we would rather tell you nothing.
notCovered.browse: Browse the services that are covered

clarify.title: One more thing
clarify.hint: Answer this and we can find the right service.

result.basedOn: Drawn from {count, plural, one {# fact} other {# facts}} in the record
result.ungrounded: The explanation could not be verified against the record, so only the checked facts below are shown.

feedback.thanks: Thank you — this helps us decide what to document next.

verification.unverifiedTitle: This record has not been verified
verification.unverifiedBody: No one has checked these details against an official source. Fees and office locations are hidden, because a wrong one would send you on a wasted trip. Confirm everything with the responsible office before you travel.
verification.suppressed: Hidden until this record is verified

checklist.title: Your checklist
checklist.saveFailed: Could not save your progress. Your ticks are still shown here.

reviews.heading: Community reports
reviews.unverifiedBody: These are people's own accounts of using this service. No one has checked them against an official source, and offices change their requirements without notice. Where a report disagrees with the official steps above, follow the official steps.
reviews.empty: No one has shared their experience of this service yet.
reviews.flagFailed: Could not send your report. Please try again.

form.heading: What happened when you used this service?
form.hint: Describe what you went through. Leave out phone numbers and links — reports containing them are rejected.
form.bodyPlaceholder: For example: the office asked for a copy I did not know about, so I had to come back the next day.
form.success: Posted. Thank you for helping the next person.

errors.invalid: Please write between {min} and {max} characters, with no links or phone numbers.
errors.rate-limited: You have posted a few reports already. Please try again later.
errors.unavailable: Reports cannot be saved right now, so yours was not posted. Please try again later.

services.heading: All services
services.subheading: Everything currently in the knowledge base.
services.empty: No services have been added yet.

states.errorBody: We could not load this page. Trying again usually works.
states.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist.

footer.disclaimer: GovGuide is an independent project, not an official government service. Always confirm details with the responsible office before you travel.
